faqs.question: What is a normal adult weight range for a Scottish Fold?
faqs.answer: This breed record lists 6-13 lb (2.7-6 kg). Your veterinarian sets the target for the individual using body condition, not only the breed average.

faqs.answer: At least every 30 days for a senior Scottish Fold, sooner if appetite, thirst, or mobility changes.
